annotations.title: What we read where, chain by rail by stage

description: BEFORE YOU READ AN ABSENCE AS A ZERO, ask what we read where. One cell per chain, rail and version, each with FOUR STAGES that are never one word: `protocolSupports`, `deploymentVerified`, `aspernReads`, `historyBackfilled`, each yes, partial, no or unknown (unknown is never no: an endpoint that refused is not a chain without the registry), plus `notObservable`, what no reader of ours can see there. Each cell names its `source`, `readMethod`, `deployment`, `population` with what it counts, `historyStart`/`historyEnd`, `indexedThrough` and `lastHeartbeat`. `datesEvents: false` means rows are dated by our scan, so no 30-day figure exists (Solana’s ERC-8004 port and MPL registry). `finder.participants: unavailable` means the rail is read but its participants are not searchable in find_agents (Tempo Machine Payments). A chain and rail NOT LISTED was not asked, which is not a zero. Free.

chain.description: One chain, e.g. solana, base, tempo, cardano.

rail.description: One rail key: erc8004-identity, erc8004-reputation, erc8004-solana, mpl-solana, x402, solana-channels, mpp, acp, mech, masumi, masumi-registry, trc8004.

name: coverage_matrix

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

asOf.description: The same instant, under the name every answer uses.

at.description: When the matrix was built from the readers’ state.

cannotSee.description: What no cell here can reach.

cells.description: Every field on every cell, null where it does not apply: key, chain, rail, railName, version, family, unit, stages, stage, notObservable, readMethod, datesEvents, deployment, source, job, population, populationMeans, scannedAt, historyStart, historyEnd, indexedThrough, lastHeartbeat, finder {rail, participants, why}, says.

checkedNotDeployed.description: Chains the ERC-8004 sweep asked and found no registry on, so they are not read as unasked.

filters.description: `chain`, `rail` and `family` as applied, null where not asked.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

total.description: Cells in the whole matrix before filters.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
